title: Chords of longest cycles

model_contract.hypothesis: G is a finite 3-vertex-connected graph and C is a longest cycle.
model_contract.conclusion: Every longest cycle has a chord.
model_contract.counterexample_condition: G is a finite 3-vertex-connected graph and C is a longest cycle. and NOT (Every longest cycle has a chord.)
model_contract.witness: A canonical graph and a chordless cycle whose length equals the exact circumference.
